text:
74세 여성 환자. SBP secondary to cirrhosis로 입원함.

BP 100/60 mmHg. HR 98 bpm. RR 24 breaths/min. BT 37.8°C. SpO2 92% on room air.

Abdominal pain moderate 호소함.

Ceftriaxone 2g IV q12h 투여 중.

Nasal cannula at 2 L/min 적용함.

Foley 유지함.

Strict input/output monitoring 시행 중.

Clinical status drowsy 확인됨.

Decreased urine output 및 abdominal distension 담당의 notify함.
